quality.basis: 第五类构建失败：注入的代码不在任何被构建的程序里

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: The exploit only compiles a pasted copy of the source into a stub program (which fails to compile on the vulnerable tree), and the injected OpenSSL plugin is not compiled by the OSS-Fuzz build.

review.note: generates a test program from the source; it fails to compile (exit 125), which counted as triggered

category5.design: Unusable: UA_BUILD_OSS_FUZZ forces the mbedTLS crypto backend, so plugins/crypto/openssl/securitypolicy_common.c is never compiled, and the project's OSS-Fuzz build does not complete in the dataset image (its /out holds only llvm-symbolizer); the spec names the project's main fuzz target so the bundle exists and says why.
